usedFor: Breezy HR tracks applicants, and “New Candidate” or “New Active Position” shows hiring moving while “Create candidate” adds people.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create candidate” in Breezy HR
bestTemplate.why: A booked interview meeting can add the person as a candidate, so nothing is typed twice.

watchOut: “New Candidate” is polling, so a new applicant may show up a little later.
